newsitem.title: USA: ChiRex Inc adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: ChiRex Inc adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: ChiRex Inc said Thursday its board of directors adopted a shareholder rights plan designed to protect ChiRex stockholders against abusive takeover tactics.
The rights would be triggered if a party bought or tried to buy more than 15 percent of the company's outstanding common.
A dividend of one right will be distributed for each outstanding share as of March 31, the company said. The right will be attached to the common stock and initially will not be exercisable.
Each right would entitle the holder to buy, for $50, one one-thousandth of a share of Series A Participating Cumulative Preferred Stock.
ChiRex said it is not aware of any current attempts to gain a controlling interest in the company.
